During starting, the ABS failure warning light comes on and remains on for more than 4 seconds.

(after carrying out the initial control unit test, the warning light should go out, ...)

If the vehicle is not fitted with ABS , a special bridge is located on the back of the instrument against the symbol representing the relevant system. The warning light stays permanently on if this is missing.
